title: Agent incident state
description: Unified incident state file written by Quinn (workflow/pipeline anomalies) and Lox (infra/host reliability). Each agent owns its own file; this schema is the superset both must conform to after migration.

incidents.description: Slug-keyed map of incidents. Keys are stable, kebab-cased identifiers derived from the failure pattern (e.g. 'tasks-api-dev-down', 'bookmark-acpx-openai-401-no-scopes').

_meta.description: Optional operator-only metadata. Not part of the incident contract; never required. Use for last-write bookkeeping.

incident.description: Single incident record. The schema marks only `owner` and `status` as required; other fields default to safe values on read so legacy entries still validate.

owner.description: Which agent owns this entry. Set explicitly when writing; legacy entries default to filename-derived owner during read-time normalization.

firstSeen.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the incident was first observed.

lastCheckedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent check or write.

status.description: Current state of the incident. `watching` = under observation, `escalated` = needs human attention, `resolved` = fixed, `false_positive` = turned out not to be a real issue.

severity.description: How serious the incident is. `high` and `critical` are surfaced to Tom automatically by Quinn's heartbeat roll-up.

needsTom.description: Set true once the incident has been escalated to Tom (or `severity` is `high`/`critical`). Quinn's heartbeat surfaces these.

attempts.description: Number of times the owning agent has attempted to investigate/auto-recover.

escalatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the incident was first escalated. Null if never escalated.

resolvedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the incident was resolved. Null if still open.

nextRetryAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the earliest time the next retry is allowed. Used to back off auto-recovery attempts.

recurrenceCount.description: Number of times the same slug has re-appeared after resolution. Used for trending and runbook effectiveness.

lastAction.description: Free-form description of the most recent action taken (investigation, repair attempt, escalation, resolution).

details.description: Operator-defined structured context (links to PRs, runbooks, blast radius, follow-up tasks, etc.). Schema is intentionally open.

linkedPr.description: Optional shortcut for the remediation PR(s). Single string for one PR; array when multiple PRs share the root cause. Mirrors `details.linkedPr` for agents that prefer a top-level field.

linkedRunbook.description: Optional shortcut for the runbook path(s). Mirrors `details.linkedRunbook`.

followUp.description: Optional list of follow-up items. Each entry is a short string (a task, PR, or note).

dailyReviewDate.description: Lox-specific: the daily review date that produced this entry. Format YYYY-MM-DD.
